selection.ownership: Conductor (conductor.build) cloud development platform. Not Conductor Monitoring (api.cm.conductor.com) and not Netflix Conductor/Orkes. Not a mainland-China edition.

research.searchCoverage: Official Conductor Monitoring Reporting API v2 (base URL, token Authorization, GET /v2/entities/websites, segments, statistics, issues), Conductor Inc New York identity, ContentKing acquisition, and dated incident search (Conductor Monitoring/ContentKing/conductor.com + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13 after excluding Netflix Conductor OSS hits. No current unresolved Conductor Monitoring platform compromise identified. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

Official Conductor cloud API at https://api.conductor.build uses Authorization Bearer tokens created at app.conductor.build/home/api-keys. Composio CONDUCTOR toolkit (17 tools) maps onto workspaces, sessions, messages, and transcript SQL. Origin/main AppCall conductor connector targeted Conductor Monitoring instead; this recipe follows the Composio slug.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

healthcheck.description: Validate the Conductor API key with GET /me.
healthcheck.title: Healthcheck

me.get.description: Get the authenticated Conductor identity and organization via GET /me. Maps to CONDUCTOR_GET_CURRENT_USER.
me.get.title: Get current user

projects.list.description: List repositories the caller can create workspaces in via GET /v0/projects. Maps to CONDUCTOR_LIST_PROJECTS.
projects.list.title: List projects

projects.get.description: Get one Conductor project by id via GET /v0/projects/{projectId}. Maps to CONDUCTOR_GET_PROJECT.
projects.get.title: Get project

workspaces.list.description: List cloud workspaces visible to the caller via GET /v0/workspaces. Maps to CONDUCTOR_LIST_WORKSPACES.

channel.description: Desktop-app channel the returned deepLink should open.

state.description: Filter by workspace state. Repeat or pass comma-separated values.

repo.description: Repository URL substring or repository id.

includeArchived.description: Include archived workspaces. Defaults to false.

workspaces.list.title: List workspaces

workspaces.get.description: Get one cloud workspace via GET /v0/workspaces/{workspaceId}. Maps to CONDUCTOR_GET_WORKSPACE.

channel.description: Desktop-app channel the returned deepLink should open.

workspaces.get.title: Get workspace

workspaces.create.description: Create a cloud workspace and its first session via POST /v0/workspaces. Pass projectId or repositoryUrl. Maps to CONDUCTOR_CREATE_WORKSPACE.

projectId.description: Project id from List projects. Required unless repositoryUrl is set.

repositoryUrl.description: Git remote URL when creating from a repository instead of a project id.

name.description: Workspace name. Also names the git branch when unset on the agent side.

agent.description: Coding agent that runs the session.

model.description: Model id accepted by the chosen agent. Invalid agent/model pairs return 400.

effort.description: Thinking effort for claude and codex sessions.

fastMode.description: Enable fast mode for models that support it.

message.description: Optional first prompt queued on the new session.

channel.description: Desktop-app channel the returned deepLink should open.

workspaces.create.title: Create workspace

workspaces.rename.description: Rename a cloud workspace via POST /v0/workspaces/{workspaceId}/rename. Maps to CONDUCTOR_RENAME_WORKSPACE.

channel.description: Desktop-app channel the returned deepLink should open.

workspaces.rename.title: Rename workspace

workspaces.change_state.description: Archive, unarchive, or sleep a workspace via POST /v0/workspaces/{workspaceId}/{state}. Maps to CONDUCTOR_CHANGE_WORKSPACE_STATE.

state.description: Lifecycle action. archive hides the workspace, unarchive restores it, sleep keeps it visible and resumable.

workspaces.change_state.title: Change workspace state

sessions.list.description: List agent sessions in a workspace via GET /v0/workspaces/{workspaceId}/sessions. Maps to CONDUCTOR_LIST_SESSIONS.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id whose sessions to list.

channel.description: Desktop-app channel the returned deepLink should open.

includeArchived.description: Include archived sessions. Defaults to false.

sessions.list.title: List sessions

sessions.create.description: Add another agent chat to an existing workspace via POST /v0/sessions. Maps to CONDUCTOR_CREATE_SESSION.

workspaceId.description: Workspace that owns the new session.

agent.description: Coding agent that runs the session.

model.description: Model id accepted by the chosen agent. Invalid agent/model pairs return 400.

effort.description: Thinking effort for claude and codex sessions.

fastMode.description: Enable fast mode for models that support it.

message.description: Optional first prompt queued on the new session.

channel.description: Desktop-app channel the returned deepLink should open.

sessions.create.title: Create session

sessions.get.description: Get one agent session via GET /v0/sessions/{sessionId}. Maps to CONDUCTOR_GET_SESSION.

channel.description: Desktop-app channel the returned deepLink should open.

sessions.get.title: Get session

sessions.rename.description: Rename an agent session via POST /v0/sessions/{sessionId}/rename. Maps to CONDUCTOR_RENAME_SESSION.

channel.description: Desktop-app channel the returned deepLink should open.

sessions.rename.title: Rename session

sessions.cancel.description: Stop the agent's current turn and drop queued messages via POST /v0/sessions/{sessionId}/cancel. Maps to CONDUCTOR_STOP_SESSION.
sessions.cancel.title: Stop session

messages.list.description: Read a session transcript via GET /v0/sessions/{sessionId}/messages. Prefer after over offset when polling. Maps to CONDUCTOR_LIST_MESSAGES.

after.description: Return only messages after this message id (exclusive). Cannot be combined with offset.

messages.list.title: List messages

messages.get.description: Get one transcript message via GET /v0/messages/{messageId}. Maps to CONDUCTOR_GET_MESSAGE.
messages.get.title: Get message

messages.create.description: Send or queue a prompt on a session via POST /v0/sessions/{sessionId}/messages. Maps to CONDUCTOR_SEND_MESSAGE.

message.description: Prompt text sent to the coding agent.

channel.description: Desktop-app channel the returned deepLink should open.

messages.create.title: Send message

transcripts.query.description: Run a read-only SQL SELECT over session_transcripts_view via POST /v0/sql. Maps to CONDUCTOR_QUERY_TRANSCRIPTS.

query.description: Read-only SQL SELECT against session_transcripts_view only.

transcripts.query.title: Query transcripts
